about.text: A journey of purity, elegance, and transformative skincare since 2020

Founded by skincare visionary Elena Moreau, LUMIÈRE ÉCLAT was born from a simple belief: true beauty comes from purity, intention, and self-care. What began as a small atelier in Provence has grown into a beloved skincare destination, trusted by those who seek the finest ingredients and transformative results.

Elena's philosophy was revolutionary for its time: harness the power of nature, honor traditional formulations, and deliver results without compromise. Today, guided by her daughter Sofia, we continue this legacy, creating products that nourish not just the skin, but the soul.
"Skincare is self-care. Every ritual is an act of love." - Elena Moreau
We source only the finest botanicals, ethically harvested from sustainable farms around the world. Every ingredient is selected for its potency and purity.
Each formula is carefully crafted in small batches, ensuring the highest quality and potency. Our master formulators bring decades of expertise to every creation.
We believe skincare is more than routine—it's a moment of connection with yourself. Our products are designed to transform your daily ritual into a sacred practice.
To create skincare that celebrates natural beauty, nurtures the skin, and elevates the soul. We are committed to purity, sustainability, and the art of self-care.

Each LUMIÈRE ÉCLAT formulation begins with extensive research into the most effective natural ingredients. Our master formulators combine time-honored traditions with cutting-edge science, creating products that deliver visible results while respecting your skin's natural balance.

From our cold-pressed extraction methods to our gentle preservation systems, every step is meticulously designed to preserve the integrity of our ingredients. The result? Potent, effective formulas that feel luxurious on the skin.
Elena Moreau opens her first atelier in Provence, France, creating small-batch skincare using local botanicals and traditional French formulation techniques.
LUMIÈRE ÉCLAT gains international recognition, with our signature Radiance Serum becoming a cult favorite among skincare enthusiasts worldwide.
We launch our carbon-neutral initiative, committing to 100% sustainable packaging and ethical sourcing across our entire supply chain.
With a loyal community of over 500,000 customers worldwide, we continue our mission to redefine skincare as an act of self-love and conscious beauty.
A third-generation chemist and herbalist, Elena brings over 30 years of experience in natural skincare formulation and a deep passion for botanical science.
Sofia combines her background in sustainable design with her mother's formulation expertise to create products that are both beautiful and effective.
A cosmetic chemist with a PhD in dermatological science, James ensures every formula meets the highest standards of efficacy and safety.
Amara leads our ethical sourcing initiatives, ensuring every ingredient is responsibly harvested and every package is thoughtfully designed for circularity.
We believe that true beauty is honest, sustainable, and accessible. Every product we create is a reflection of our dedication to purity, efficacy, and the well-being of our planet.

Our Radiance Renewal Serum is a powerhouse formula designed to transform dull, tired skin into a luminous, youthful complexion. Formulated with the highest concentration of active ingredients, this serum delivers visible results in just 14 days.
Water (Aqua), Glycerin, Hyaluronic Acid, Vitamin C (Ascorbic Acid), Niacinamide, Ferulic Acid, Jojoba Oil, Shea Butter, Vitamin E, Green Tea Extract, Aloe Vera, Rosemary Extract.
Free From:Parabens, Sulfates, Phthalates, Synthetic Fragrance, Mineral Oil, Animal Testing

Apply 2-3 drops to clean, dry skin morning and night. Gently massage into face, neck, and décolletage until fully absorbed. Follow with moisturizer. For best results, use consistently and always wear SPF during the day.
Pro Tip:For enhanced results, apply while skin is slightly damp from your toner to lock in maximum hydration.
